0.title: [2026] REALM-CA 1
0.ratio: Appeal dismissed unanimously. The s. 8/s. 5 sequencing complaint is not made out; s. 8 cannot be applied without implicitly applying s. 5, so the complaint describes a structural impossibility. REALM-PC 1 confirmed good law.

1.title: [2026] REALM-CA 2
1.ratio: VOID AB INITIO: heard by an even bench of four (s. 18). Set aside by [2026] REALM-SC 4, which re-determined the substance. Retained for the record only; nothing binds.

2.title: [2026] REALM-PC 1
2.ratio: A governance system is fit for alpha release where the core legal model is coherent, statute + procedure + founding caselaw are committed, constitutional enforcement is in place, and known gaps are disclosed; convenience tooling is not a prerequisite for alpha; deterministic citation numbering is a necessary condition for v1.

3.title: [2026] REALM-PC 10
3.ratio: On the Standing Committee's reference: the realm has a delegated power (Bill 14) but no instantiated, uniform route to make/amend/repeal/enforce statutory instruments; cure is one SI framework (best as an amendment to Bill 14) adding a binding-regulation estate tier, an amend procedure, a Bill 16 citation slot and a Bill 13 enforcement receiver, plus short per-Act enabling clauses. Completes rather than amends the settlement (no leapfrog). The Committee's default act is to make/amend SIs; fresh statutes are exceptional.

4.title: [2026] REALM-PC 11
4.ratio: The SI citation form is Form C (HYBRID): a flat global annual ordinal [YEAR] REALM-SI N minted by the unchanged deterministic engine on one REALM-SI code, always shown with a derived, recital-extracted parent tag (under Bill NN); the enabling power is always recited in full (recitals govern, the tag is a derived pointer); an amending SI is a fresh flat SI with its own tag, the amend link a register pointer; SI status vocab = made/in-force/amended/revoked/spent. Completes the scheme (no leapfrog).

5.title: [2026] REALM-PC 12
5.ratio: Lexby (CASE-LAW s. 3) holds NO authority to draft instruments of law or author judgments on its own account; such text is void AS AN INSTRUMENT from issue (counsel, not the organ or the bench) but admissible as a void first draft leapfrogging to the Committee's second-draft stage; adoption by the proper organ (Committee vote + Royal Assent; or a counted bench) is constitutive and CURES the origin defect, so already-adopted text stands (entry-by-entry, non-infectious, conforming [2026] REALM-SC 7); engineering remains Lexby's under s. 3, the test being the SOURCE OF THE ARTEFACT'S FORCE (function vs promulgation by an organ). FOUNDATIONAL; escalation to the full Supreme Court recommended.

6.title: [2026] REALM-PC 2
6.ratio: VJS is ready for public outreach under reasonable skill and care provided the README carries a prominently placed known-limitations section first; public outreach is a materially distinct standard from alpha release; coherence and honest disclosure are necessary and sufficient.

7.title: [2026] REALM-PC 3
7.ratio: Where a feature of a governance system is the load-bearing differentiator that a first-time reader must grasp before a sound adoption decision can be made, the README must carry that feature prominently. 8.title: [2026] REALM-PC 4
8.ratio: A deterministic, token-free retrieval index over the committed markdown is a permitted screening device under s. 12 on three cumulative conditions (index-not-replacement; adoption gated on a pre-stated measured trigger and presently FORBIDDEN; cheaper token-free intermediates exhausted first). Until the gate trips the s. 8 duty is to monitor and report, not build.

9.title: [2026] REALM-PC 5
9.ratio: The "framework-seeding" inclusion doctrine; held an unmoored extension (s. 17) and no part of the law. Superseded by [2026] REALM-SC 4.

10.title: [2026] REALM-PC 6
10.ratio: Harvest only generic, fact-free, provenance-clean method to enhance the harness; never rubric criteria or answers (fast-path application of REALM-SC 4).

11.title: [2026] REALM-PC 7
11.ratio: Two sealed rooms: the agent room never sees the rubric; the marker room may. Admissibility of anonymised scoring and self-marking (fast-path application of REALM-SC 4).

12.title: [2026] REALM-PC 8
12.ratio: One spine, domain DIVISIONS not domain COURTS (affirmed by REALM-SC 5).

13.title: [2026] REALM-PC 9
13.ratio: A Sweet & Maxwell / Restatement-style practitioner treatise capturing the Legal Division's learnings is permitted, provenance-clean, chaptered by capability.

14.title: [2026] REALM-SC 1
14.ratio: Breach is the tort of negligence (duty + graded endeavours + remediation only); the system is a unitary realm of parliamentary sovereignty (one global CASE-LAW, jurisdiction-local case law, one apex court).

15.title: [2026] REALM-SC 2
15.ratio: s. 4 imposes a proactive disclosure obligation: Lexby must raise known material risks to the principal's project even when not asked; silence in the face of a known material risk is breach; remedy under s. 6 is disclosure and restoration. Majority 4:1.

16.title: [2026] REALM-SC 3
16.ratio: Six reforms (VARIED 8:1): leapfrog as reviewable executive routing act; two-sided researched intake as the content of the s. 3 case file; apex-only observer; independent leave-judge; non-adjudicating per-turn watchdog; deterministic pre-commit citation-integrity gate.

17.title: [2026] REALM-SC 4
17.ratio: Every bench must be odd-numbered and its sizes are the total deciding membership; the judgment is authored by one counted member (the synthesiser-on-top pattern abolished); a ruling by an improperly constituted bench is void ab initio. Anti-cheat: only generic, answer-key-free methodology may enter a scored-agent prompt. Enacts s. 18.

18.title: [2026] REALM-SC 5
18.ratio: The realm is one unitary court organised into domain DIVISIONS over one spine, never fractured into domain COURTS owning parallel law/citators/apexes (s. 9); a product advice feature is outside VJS governance (s. 14). Enacts s. 21.

19.title: [2026] REALM-SC 6
19.ratio: The realm may be a super-repo over a Ministry of Justice + operational repos, each repo a local County Court hearing-centre of the one judiciary, while the single Court of Appeal and Supreme Court stay central; the singleness of the apex may never be relaxed; apex enactment is non-delegable. Enacts s. 22.

20.title: [2026] REALM-SC 7
20.ratio: Pre-enactment precedent is judged ENTRY-BY-ENTRY on the deterministic record, never wholesale; Bill 25 s.6(2) and CASE-LAW s.18(5) INTERLOCK (the savings carve out the void, an ordinary Act cannot revive it); s.18(5) is PROSPECTIVE in reach (the entrenchment lock vs s.10 compels it), deep+incurable in quality; the s.18(5) vice is a found fact on a specific bench, never presumed from age and not infectious; a legacy repo owes only restorative, prospective conformance (new matters use the new machinery; mark void only on a found improper bench; integrity-chain stays intact). VARIED 9:0 (leapfrog, s.20); acmeco CONFORMANT-PROJECTION; CC-ACMECO 1-11 saved (2 per-incuriam), CC-ACMECO 12 remitted (found SAVED: full court of 9, unanimous).

21.title: [2026] REALM-SC 8
21.ratio: Lexby (CASE-LAW s. 3) holds NO law-making or adjudicative drafting authority; the authoritative text of an instrument is the Committee's (drafting) + the Sovereign's (enactment), of a judgment the constituted bench's. Un-adopted Lexby instrument-text is VOID as an instrument on its own account (6-3); a Lexby-authored ratio that IS the decision is void ab initio under s. 18(5) (unanimous, applying [2026] REALM-SC 4). Remedy CURATIVE not destructive: the text leapfrogs as a void FIRST DRAFT into the Committee's second-draft stage (or the s. 18(4) registrar route for judgments), and ADOPTION by the proper organ is constitutive and CURES the origin defect (spent on adoption), so the enacted statute book (Bills 1-27), REALM-SI 1, and REALM-SC 1-7 / REALM-CA 1 / the Privy Council line STAND (entry-by-entry, non-infectious, conforming [2026] REALM-SC 7). Engineering is Lexby's, the test being the SOURCE OF THE ARTEFACT'S FORCE (function vs promulgation). The Court RULES the principle and DIRECTS the Standing Committee to draft a clarifying s. 3 limb; it does not legislate the text itself. Affirms [2026] REALM-PC 12.
